digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 usage aggregation and sidecar instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 findings functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call usage attached by runner.run, preventing token totals and per-criterion request counts from reaching batch outputs and coverage metrics

Multi-criterion chunks require token field division across criteria while deriving per-criterion llm_calls counts from call records, and ladder retries must each contribute a call record with no usage recovery for raising attempts

Usage must be threaded through the full call chain (sizing.pass1_with_ladder → passes functions → concurrent collectors → ProductionBatchRunner) and aggregated as per_call records and per_criterion attribution, then persisted in sidecar payload and coverage.metrics

run_focused_finder must accumulate and return usage from its recursive run_bin closure, and checkpoint-served chunks must contribute zero usage while all other callers across eval_solver, criterion_preview, and fidelity_spot_eval must unpack the new return shapes atomically
